tokens.name: page-bg

tokens.name: lodge-blue
tokens.usage: Brotherhood, loyalty, ceremonial authority. Used as text on `.emblem-icon::before`, `.page-title h2`, `.stat-value`. 10.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: ceremonial-gold

Used as text on `.page-title h2::first-letter`, `.page-title::after`, `.section-header::before`; border on `.degree-level:hover`. 2.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
